title: Lieb-Robinson bounds for irreversible dynamics via adaptive Dyson expansion
summary: In this note, we study a broad class of time-dependent and irreversible dynamics for quantum spin systems in both finite and infinite volume. We develop a simple and flexible strategy for expanding commutators of the form $[A,τ_{s,t} \, B]$ in terms of self-avoiding paths of sets, where $A$ and $B$ are local operators and $τ_{s,t}$ is the Heisenberg time evolution. This adaptive Dyson expansion requires no backwards time evolution and is thus also applicable to irreversible dynamics.
